verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document tracking initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team as a product capability. The closest items are developer building blocks: shipping custom board column types and API events such as change_column_value. These are primitives for constructing the capability, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Ship new reusable workflow blocks, agent skills, and board column types.
